description.value:
You pick up a pair of at-will tech powers. At 3rd level you learn a 1st-level tech power you can cast once per long rest, and at 5th level you learn a 2nd-level tech power you can likewise cast once per long rest. Intelligence is your techcasting ability for these powers, and casting them requires a wristpad.

If you had the Tech-Impaired trait, you no longer have it.
